craft.title: Checked Against the Record
craft.excerpt: In a test case, a local coding agent says it updated two files and the records show one. What a harness can establish about its own turn, how it labels the claims it recognizes and cannot match, and what it states it did not check.

craft.title: Inside a Trust Harness, in Java 21
craft.excerpt: One edit request followed through a local coding assistant written in plain Java 21. Where a model's suggestion becomes an action, which part of the runtime owns each step, and where the containment stops.

cosmos.title: Twelve Local Models, One Harness That Checks Them
cosmos.excerpt: Twelve open-weight models went through a qualification protocol in July 2026. Six finished a 72-trial run and passed every trust gate in every trial. Forty-three of the 102 failed trials were results affected by runtime or scoring behavior, so those results cannot be treated as clean measurements of model quality.

cosmos.title: My 1st Year as a Software Engineer, Lessons Learned
cosmos.excerpt: Reflections on my first year as a software engineer, embracing challenges, asking for help, and the importance of kindness.

codex.title: The Work-Test Cycle
codex.excerpt: How Talos is built. An edit loop and a release gate, six gates in one task, one record per batch, and a few distinctions kept apart. A focused pass is not acceptance, an exit code is not a result, and review agreement is not execution evidence.

codex.title: Fail Fast, Learn Faster. Instinct, on Purpose
codex.excerpt: This guide shows how to run safe-to-fail experiments in life plus at work. Build a personal system where every attempt either moves you forward or pays you back in information.

convergence.title: From a RAG CLI to an Execution Harness
convergence.excerpt: How a local retrieval tool called LOQ-J became Talos. The decisions that shaped it, what most of them cost, and what was built and then taken out on purpose.
